name: Camping 101: Fishing

faq.answer: Fenn Fairweather teaches the Fish Bowl craft in Shen'dar Village. Show enough skill in fishing, and Fenn can teach you to make one for camp.
faq.q: Who teaches the Fish Bowl camping craft?

faq.answer: A Fish Bowl is a decorative fixture that brings comfort and cheer to you and your companions at camp. A well-kept camp and high spirits help you stay sharp and ready for danger in the field.
faq.q: What purpose does a Fish Bowl serve at camp?

faq.answer: Shen'dar Village is a gathering place for tradesfolk and instructors, including Fenn Fairweather. Anglers go there to learn practical camping crafts suited to their skills.

aliases: when can i learn fish bowl
faq.answer: You need to show basic skill as an angler before learning this craft. Once your fishing is well honed, instructors in Shen'dar Village can teach you to make camp fixtures such as the Fish Bowl.
faq.q: What skill is required to learn this camping craft?

faq.answer: Fishing brings in food, and an angler's patience and keen eye can also improve camp life. A fresh catch displayed in a crafted bowl offers calm and lifts spirits during long wilderness journeys.
faq.q: Why does fishing matter for wilderness camping?

faq.answer: Fenn Fairweather is an artisan and instructor in Shen'dar Village. Fenn knows the practical comforts of wilderness life and shares camp fixture craft with skilled anglers.

sections.body: A camp in the wild needs comfort along with sharp blades and sturdy armor. Good spirits help companions bear the strain of life in the field. Fishing brings provisions, and skilled anglers can put their craft to work improving a campsite. With live fish and a proper fixture, a traveler can make camp more welcoming.
sections.title: Comforts of the Hearth

sections.body: In Shen'dar Village, Fenn Fairweather shares fishing secrets with seasoned anglers who know the patience of rod and reel. Anglers with enough skill can learn to make a Fish Bowl, a simple fixture that brings cheer and rest to weary companions. Good spirits in the wild help a group stay focused and resolute when danger draws near.
sections.title: The Artisan of Shen'dar

summary: You are learning how fishing can make wilderness camps more welcoming. In Shen'dar Village, skilled anglers can ask Fenn Fairweather to teach them the Fish Bowl craft.
